study_type_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic studies of EXT-Sol and EXT-SBA-15 were conducted in healthy male SD rats.

in_vivo_species.quote: Sprague-Dawley (SD) rats (250 ± 20 g) and ICR mice (25 ± 5 g) were supplied by SLRC Laboratory Animal Ltd.

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: ICR, 25 ± 5 g, STZ type 2 diabetes model (efficacy only)
in_vivo_species.quote: Type 2 diabetes model was induced by STZ with multiple injection method into ICR mice.

agents.name: EXT-Sol (distribution phase)
agents.sequence_source: Not printed in the body, which names the drug only as exenatide (mw. 4186.63). Sequence is PEPlife2's.
agents.chemical_identifier: exenatide (EXT); SBA-15 mesoporous silica carrier for EXT-SBA-15
agents.group_n_quote: Sixteen rats were randomly divided into two groups (n = 8)
agents.dose_route_quote: SD rats were received s.c. administration of EXT-Sol and EXT-SBA-15 at a single EXT dose of 50 μg/kg, respectively.
agents.half_life_elimination: not applicable (this record is the distribution phase)
agents.pk_quote: The EXT-SBA-15 treatment group extended the half-life t 1/2(β) to 14.53 ± 0.70 h compared with that of the EXT solution (EXT-Sol) treatment group (0.60 ± 0.08 h) in vivo.

bioanalytical_method: Exendin-4 ELISA kit (Phoenix Pharmaceuticals EK-070-94); parameters computed in PKSolver 2.0
bioanalytical_quote: The plasma concentrations of EXT were measured by Exendin-4 ELISA kit according to the instructions supplied by the manufacturer.
notes: All four PEPlife2 values verified exactly against Table 1: t1/2(alpha) 0.22 ± 0.03 and 0.26 ± 0.05 h, t1/2(beta) 0.60 ± 0.08 and 14.53 ± 0.70 h. SEQUENCE DEFECT: PEPlife2's string is HGEGTFTSDLSKQMEEEAVRLFIEWLKNGOPSSGAPPPS, which carries an 'O' where exenatide has a glycine (the native sequence is ...IEWLKNGGPSSGAPPPS). O is not one of the 20 standard residues; ESM-2 accepts it as a rare token but carries essentially no pretraining signal for it, so this row and its three siblings are embedded from a slightly corrupted sequence. The body names the drug only as 'Exenatide (mw. 4186.63)' and never prints a sequence, so the error cannot be repaired from the full text. The 24-fold gap between EXT-Sol and EXT-SBA-15 elimination half-lives is a property of the mesoporous silica carrier, not of the peptide: both rows carry the identical sequence, so this pair is a clean illustration of formulation dominating the label.
